name: app-feature-carousel-strip
title: App Feature Carousel Strip
description: A horizontally scrollable feature card carousel highlighting key workflow moments.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- App Feature Carousel Strip Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
